The candidate assumes the same cleaning schedule as the baseline, but it does not address the root cause of clogging, which is the recirculated water with scale particles and biological growth. The proposed solution only treats the symptoms, not the underlying issue. This is evident from the baseline failure, where the same cleaning schedule fails to prevent clogging.
